Specific checks only; not full interoperability or Windows policy equivalence. CAB adds an independent jsign 7.6 signature and payload-tampered counterpart; limited standard-reserve layout only. PowerShell adds independently jsign 7.6-signed UTF-8 BOM, UTF-16LE, and UTF-16BE scripts and an isolated payload-tampered counterpart. RDP adds a pinned nfedera/rdpsign-produced detached signature and mutation counterparts; no Microsoft rdpsign.exe interoperability validation. PowerShell XML adds jsign 7.6-signed ASCII and BOM-marked UTF-8/UTF-16LE/BE fixtures, an isolated digest-tampered pair, and explicit rejection of a signed Windows-1252 artifact. MSIX/AppX adds an independently jsign 7.6-signed package and an unchanged upstream signtool-signed ZIP64 package; specific integrity checks only, not Windows policy equivalence. WSH adds independent jsign 7.6 signatures for all five extensions and UTF-8 BOM Unicode for VBScript/JScript/WSF; encoded envelopes establish stored-text hashing only, not runtime validity.
